correctness.rationale: The two-site outgoing Green-function equations give iff phase equation (1); modulus gives |U|=|V|. Opposite signs impose Lk=m pi. Equal signs produce the exact Chebyshev polynomial and a phase with at most one interior minimum; endpoint inequalities prove the L versus L-1 count, and endpoint polynomial derivatives prove the square-root law. The direct transfer-matrix checker independently passed 2714 finite checks, but finite checks are not the proof.
